about: Structured re-verification of policy-critical facts (checklist C-01 to C-16, data_sources §13) plus non-critical facts cited by rules. Each term anchor (a short phrase) must appear in the fact's cited L1 section of the hash-pinned 2026-10-28 snapshot; numbers in the statement are checked automatically. Notes record the agent's reading of conditions, applicant group and exceptions. Not a live-page check (HDB blocks automated access); see D-058 as revised.
